cells: Shared project channel for working questions
Record decisions with owners and dates

meetings.title: Backlog refinement
meetings.summary: Prepare future stories and clarify dependencies.
meetings.detail: Review requirements, acceptance criteria, estimates, and open questions before sprint planning.

meetings.title: Sprint planning
meetings.detail: Confirm goals, capacity, dependencies, and scope before work begins.

meetings.title: Daily standup
meetings.summary: Surface progress, blockers, and collaboration needs.
meetings.detail: Keep updates concise and move detailed problem solving into focused follow-up sessions.

meetings.title: Sprint demonstration
meetings.summary: Review working functionality and capture feedback.
meetings.detail: Demonstrate completed scenarios; record decisions and refinement needs in the backlog.

meetings.title: Retrospective
meetings.detail: Agree a small set of owned improvements and review their effect next sprint.

meetings.title: Program status
meetings.detail: Maintain shared visibility of schedule changes, blockers, and needed decisions.

meetings.title: Steering committee
meetings.detail: Review delivery health and decisions requiring executive direction.

meetings.title: Change and adoption sync
meetings.detail: Review user feedback and planned enablement activities alongside delivery progress.

items.title: Protect collaboration time
items.summary: Agree overlapping hours across the team.
items.detail: Use the shared calendar to identify collaboration windows. Surface availability changes early.

items.title: Keep decisions visible
items.summary: Maintain one shared record of work and decisions.
items.detail: Record acceptance criteria, decisions, test evidence, and delivery progress in the agreed tracking system.

items.title: Raise blockers early
items.summary: Make dependencies and support needs explicit.
items.detail: Name an owner and the needed decision when raising a blocker; use the agreed escalation path when timing threatens delivery.
